senses.gloss: pr. n. m.M’sarbay, by-name of the family of Jojarib.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:11">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵈ</cite> <he>מ׳ מ̇ס̇ר̇ ב̇י̇י̇תא וכ׳</he> he was surnamed M., because he surrendered the Temple to the enemy; … <he>יה הֵרִיב … על שמ̇ר̇ו וס̇ר̇ב̇ו בו</he> the Lord went into judgment … because they rebelled against him.
